title: Karnataka Arogya Sanjeevini Scheme (KASS) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government health scheme for eligible Karnataka government employees and related beneficiaries under the state employee health framework.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible Karnataka government employees and specified dependants/pensioner categories as notified under KASS rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Karnataka Arogya Sanjeevini Scheme (KASS).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
